_comment: Source URLs for this skill's reference files. Run scripts/update-references.py to refresh. references/*.md cover V1; references/v2/*.md cover native V2.

references/providers.md.covers: V1: provider config, model syntax, authentication, Anthropic/OpenAI/Bedrock/Vertex/Ollama setup, apiKey format, provider options

references/mcp.md.covers: V1: mcp config structure, local/remote transport types, OAuth, environment variables, CLI commands

references/agents.md.covers: V1: built-in agents (build/plan/general/explore/scout), custom agent fields, markdown file format, bash glob permissions

references/permissions.md.covers: V1: permission actions (ask/allow/deny), all tool types, bash glob patterns, defaults, global vs per-agent permissions

references/tui.md.covers: V1: tui.json structure, all keybind actions, theme configuration, mouse/scroll/diff/cursor/attention settings

references/config-schema.md.covers: V1: full opencode.json schema — top-level fields, server, commands, instructions, formatters, LSP, compaction, skills, plugins, policies, watcher, managed settings

references/v2/config-schema.md.covers: V2: config locations/precedence, all top-level fields, ignored V1 fields, commands, skills, formatters, compaction, media, websearch, warming, references, worktree, instructions, service env

references/v2/permissions.md.covers: V2: ordered permissions rules, actions/resources, defaults, approvals, experimental.policies (provider.use, permission), policy precedence

references/v2/agents.md.covers: V2: built-in agents, agents map and markdown format, fields (system, permissions, request, disabled), default agent, subagent control

references/v2/mcp.md.covers: V2: mcp.servers, local/remote fields, snake_case OAuth, timeout object, protocol, Code Mode, tool naming, CLI

references/v2/providers.md.covers: V2: providers map, packages, settings/headers/body, models and variants array, model references, Bedrock/Vertex/Azure/Copilot/local runtimes, credential storage

references/v2/cli.md.covers: V2: global cli.json settings, keybind IDs, theme selection and V2 theme format, CLI-only plugins, tui.json migration

references/v2/plugins.md.covers: V2: plugins config and discovery, enable/disable directives, plugin CLI, Plugin.define API, V1 hook mapping

references/v2/migration.md.covers: V1 to V2: breaking changes, mixing rules, field renames for permissions/agents/commands/MCP/compaction/providers/models, file locations
